mapper.select: /* JournalDreamMapper.getDeletedById */ SELECT dream.id, dream.created_by, dream.journal_day_id, dream.sort_order, day.yy AS yy, day.mnth AS mnth FROM journal_dream dream LEFT JOIN journal_day day ON dream.journal_day_id = day.id WHERE dream.id = #{id}
/* JournalDreamMapper.findAllForReorder */ SELECT * FROM journal_dream WHERE journal_day_id = #{journalDayId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order
